text:
Marta: Quick readout — ran the 14-day GPU forecast. EU-North cluster shows an 18% runway drop vs our baseline; spike in embeddings + higher preemptions in zone-3. Posting the short snapshot.

Marta: ```region,gpu_hours,runway_pct,notes
us-west,48k,112,normal
eu-north,21k,62,preemptible-loss + embedding onboarding
apac,12k,130,steady
```

Kevin: What exactly is driving the EU delta? Preemptions or throughput?

Marta: Primarily preemptible loss in eu-north-zone3 (Azure spot churn) + a ~40% increase in embedding qps from a new customer.

Sanjay: Can we shift reserved GPUs from us-west to eu-north for the short term? That solves runway but bumps cost.

Jia: Ran a quick cost sensitivity: shifting 8 reserved GPUs -> eu-north for 7 days increases spend ~ $14k but improves p95 by ~70ms for EU traffic. Quick numbers: ```8 gpus * 24h * 7d * $2.6/hr ~= $3484 (note: multiply by reserve premium)```

ops-bot: autoscaler:scale_event eu-north-zone3 at 2026-03-12T02:14Z — scale-down triggered (maintenance window).

Noah: That maintenance window was intentional but it wasn't annotated in the forecasting pipeline; the data conflates planned down with capacity loss. We should tag planned ops.

Marta: Proposal: temporary 10% reserved uplift in eu-north and enable a 12-hour microburst pool during peak EU hours. Anyone object?

Kevin: :+1: from infra. Also request: add a preemptible->dedicated failover route in smart-routing so we carpool live traffic off spot nodes faster.

Sanjay: :thumbsup: I'll PR the routing change and update the cost runbook with the delta.

Marta: If no objections, we'll enact at 22:00 UTC tonight. I'll update the capacity sheet and ping finance.

Jia: One mitigation ask: can we lower KV-cache eviction thresholds (eviction sooner) to free memory and avoid adding GPUs? Might reduce mem pressure on embeddings. Testing now in staging.

Marta: Good call — if that stabilizes tail latency we can avoid the full shift. Keep us posted.

ops-bot: reminder: capacity-runbook review meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC.

Noah: Also opening a short-lived dashboard: /dashboards/eunorth-midweek-surge for ops visibility.

Marta: Thanks all — will post final decision after Jia's staging run and Sanjay's PR.
